chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): that he was asked about a man who converted to Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan.
What is upon him regarding fasting? He said, 'He is not upon him except what he converted in it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting for someone who converts to Islam during Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that a new Muslim (mu'allaf) is exempt from making up the days of Ramadan prior to their conversion, as the obligation of fasting begins only upon the acceptance of Islam. This ruling underscores the principle that the duties of a Muslim are contingent upon their status as a believer, distinguishing this case from one who dies before embracing the faith. It highlights the mercy in Islamic jurisprudence by relieving new converts of retrospective obligations for periods when they were not yet bound by Sharia.
